english.title: Drive on road other than motorway, fail comply with red / green arrow / lane closure light signals

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2002

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), and failed to comply with the indication given by a traffic sign specified as subject to obligatory endorsement in Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988, namely

(A)_[a red light traffic signal,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, the Traffic Signs Regulations and General Directions 2016 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Option (C) the 'green arrow traffic light signal' has been added, as they are a permitted variant of Diagram 3000 (Schedule 14, Part 2 Item 1), although it would be for the courts to determine whether section 36(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 applies to the green arrows or not.
(ii) The person making the charging decision has to decide between option (A) or (C), depending on the individual circumstances in each case, as to whether the offence applies to breaching the red or green arrow traffic light signal.
(iii) See offence document H20371 (CJS Code RT88976) for the same offence detected by automatic equipment.
(iv) Where the offence relates to signs on a motorway, please see document H20368 (CJS Code RT88973 - manual detection) or document H20369 (CJS Code RT88974 - automatic equipment).
(v) For offences committed prior to 10/10/19, please see document H19107 (CJS Code RT88971 - manual detection) or document H19108 (CJS Code RT88972 - automatic equipment), which cover both motorways and other roads.
(vi) Offence document H19028 and H19029 cater for general endorsable section 36 traffic signs (excluding stop signs, traffic lights and solid white lines)
(vii) Offence documents H12688 and H12689 cater for the contravention of stop signs.
(viii) Offence documents H12692 and H12693 cater for the contravention of solid white line road markings.
(ix) Non-endorsable section 36 traffic signs are catered for by offence documents H12682 (ACD) and H12683 (non-ACD).
